scenes.text: You’ve probably looked at a map today, but you didn't realize it was lying to you on purpose.
Cartographers actually invent fake streets, towns, and even mountains, called 'trap streets.'
Someone had actually built a real general store at those exact coordinates, naming it the Agloe General Store because they saw it on the first map.
Would you live in a town that shouldn't exist? Tell me below and follow for more!
